key_results: With 3 equal Royer cells and series secondary contribution, each cell handles about 58.48 A input, 701.75 W input, and 666.67 W output.
The per-cell nominal voltage contribution is 112 V, reducing first-order effective magnetic ratio from about 28 to about 9.33 before other gain bricks.
A current-fed choke is a full-current series power brick; its DCR/core/ripple/clamp penalties must be charged explicitly.
A resonant brick must beat its k^2 RMS conduction penalty with switching-loss savings.
A capacitive gain brick placed directly at 12 V still faces hundred-ampere charge-transfer current; higher-voltage placement is more plausible.
